caption: A neon sign glows above a rain-soaked street at night, and its coloured reflection streaks down the wet pavement toward the viewer.

sa.check: A neon sign glows above a street.
Its reflection streaks down the wet pavement toward the viewer.
It is night and the street is rain-soaked.

pc.expect: The reflection lies below the sign on the wet surface and fades where the pavement is dry.
pc.fail: It lies above the sign; or shows on dry pavement; or it is missing on plainly wet ground.

pc.expect: The reflection has the same colours as the sign.
pc.fail: It is a different colour; or brighter than the sign; or it changes colour with the sign steady.

pc.expect: The pavement is wet: the reflection shimmers where puddles ripple.
pc.fail: It is a sharp mirror image on rough ground; or it is rigid on rippling puddles; or the water flows uphill.

pc.expect: The reflection does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It drifts along the pavement; or flickers with the sign steady.
A second sign appears; or the reflection becomes solid; or the sign vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The sign's lettering and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The lettering changes; or the street rearranges; or the buildings change.
